name: Yūki (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Yūki city emblem in white: a ring crossed by a winged horizontal bar with a lozenge at the centre.
history: Municipal flag of Yūki, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 March 1951.

features.role: Yūki city emblem — a ring crossed by a winged horizontal bar with a lozenge at the centre
